The Blind Tiger family took over the Artisan in Rawtenstall in October 2017, the already established Music venue which has hosted a number of top bands from the UK will carry on the Blind tiger Ethos of great music, great people. We aren’t just about the music and atmosphere but also very important to us is the DRINKS!
